originals.name: v2-13
originals.text: 全球治理可以理解为：各国通过国际组织、共同规则与合作行动，
originals.rPr: <ns0:rPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" sz="1950" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:rPr>
originals.pPr: <ns0:pPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" algn="l"><ns0:defRPr sz="1950" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:defRPr></ns0:pPr>

originals.name: v2-14
originals.text: 协调跨国问题，回应共同利益，并在协商中明确权利与责任。
originals.rPr: <ns0:rPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" sz="1950" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:rPr>
originals.pPr: <ns0:pPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" algn="l"><ns0:defRPr sz="1950" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:defRPr></ns0:pPr>

originals.name: v2-17
originals.text: 排放与气候风险跨越国界，单一国家的行动
originals.rPr: <ns0:rPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" sz="1800" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:rPr>
originals.pPr: <ns0:pPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" algn="l"><ns0:defRPr sz="1800" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:defRPr></ns0:pPr>

originals.name: v2-18
originals.text: 需要与国际合作衔接。不同国家的脆弱处境，
originals.rPr: <ns0:rPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" sz="1800" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:rPr>
originals.pPr: <ns0:pPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" algn="l"><ns0:defRPr sz="1800" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:defRPr></ns0:pPr>

originals.name: v2-19
originals.text: 也应进入议题与方案的形成过程。
originals.rPr: <ns0:rPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" sz="1800" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:rPr>
originals.pPr: <ns0:pPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" algn="l"><ns0:defRPr sz="1800" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:defRPr></ns0:pPr>

originals.name: v2-21
originals.text: 技术发展关联各国的发展机会与安全关切。
originals.rPr: <ns0:rPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" sz="1800" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:rPr>
originals.pPr: <ns0:pPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" algn="l"><ns0:defRPr sz="1800" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:defRPr></ns0:pPr>

originals.name: v2-22
originals.text: 规则讨论需要更广泛的参与，也需要支持
originals.rPr: <ns0:rPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" sz="1800" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:rPr>
originals.pPr: <ns0:pPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" algn="l"><ns0:defRPr sz="1800" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:defRPr></ns0:pPr>

originals.name: v2-23
originals.text: 发展中国家提升专业与技术能力。
originals.rPr: <ns0:rPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" sz="1800" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:rPr>
originals.pPr: <ns0:pPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" algn="l"><ns0:defRPr sz="1800" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:defRPr></ns0:pPr>

originals.name: v2-34
originals.text: 各国的国土、人口与经济规模可以不同，
originals.rPr: <ns0:rPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" sz="1800" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:rPr>
originals.pPr: <ns0:pPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" algn="l"><ns0:defRPr sz="1800" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:defRPr></ns0:pPr>

originals.name: v2-35
originals.text: 主权与尊严都应得到尊重。各国自主选择
originals.rPr: <ns0:rPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" sz="1800" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:rPr>
originals.pPr: <ns0:pPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" algn="l"><ns0:defRPr sz="1800" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:defRPr></ns0:pPr>

originals.name: v2-36
originals.text: 社会制度与发展道路的权利同样受到尊重。
originals.rPr: <ns0:rPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" sz="1800" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:rPr>
originals.pPr: <ns0:pPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" algn="l"><ns0:defRPr sz="1800" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:defRPr></ns0:pPr>

originals.name: v2-38
originals.text: 各国也要尊重其他国家，履行国际义务。
originals.rPr: <ns0:rPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" sz="1800" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:rPr>
originals.pPr: <ns0:pPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" algn="l"><ns0:defRPr sz="1800" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:defRPr></ns0:pPr>

originals.name: v2-39
originals.text: 平等地位为协商合作提供基础，具体责任
originals.rPr: <ns0:rPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" sz="1800" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:rPr>
originals.pPr: <ns0:pPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" algn="l"><ns0:defRPr sz="1800" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:defRPr></ns0:pPr>

originals.name: v2-40
originals.text: 则需要结合承诺、能力与不同国情理解。
originals.rPr: <ns0:rPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" sz="1800" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:rPr>
originals.pPr: <ns0:pPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" algn="l"><ns0:defRPr sz="1800" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:defRPr></ns0:pPr>

originals.name: v2-52
originals.text: 各国都应有参与全球事务讨论的
originals.rPr: <ns0:rPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" sz="1650" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:rPr>
originals.pPr: <ns0:pPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" algn="l"><ns0:defRPr sz="1650" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:defRPr></ns0:pPr>

originals.name: v2-53
originals.text: 机会，特别需要关注发展中国家
originals.rPr: <ns0:rPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" sz="1650" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:rPr>
originals.pPr: <ns0:pPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" algn="l"><ns0:defRPr sz="1650" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:defRPr></ns0:pPr>

originals.name: v2-54
originals.text: 和脆弱国家的实际处境。
originals.rPr: <ns0:rPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" sz="1650" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:rPr>
originals.pPr: <ns0:pPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" algn="l"><ns0:defRPr sz="1650" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:defRPr></ns0:pPr>

originals.name: v2-55
originals.text: 例如：气候讨论应听到
originals.rPr: <ns0:rPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" sz="1500" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="687368" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:rPr>
originals.pPr: <ns0:pPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" algn="l"><ns0:defRPr sz="1500" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="687368" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:defRPr></ns0:pPr>

originals.name: v2-56
originals.text: 小岛国对海平面上升的关切。
originals.rPr: <ns0:rPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" sz="1500" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="687368" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:rPr>
originals.pPr: <ns0:pPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" algn="l"><ns0:defRPr sz="1500" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="687368" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:defRPr></ns0:pPr>

originals.name: v2-61
originals.text: 各国的合理关切应得到尊重，
originals.rPr: <ns0:rPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" sz="1650" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:rPr>
originals.pPr: <ns0:pPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" algn="l"><ns0:defRPr sz="1650" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:defRPr></ns0:pPr>

originals.name: v2-62
originals.text: 在议题设置与方案设计中形成
originals.rPr: <ns0:rPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" sz="1650" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:rPr>
originals.pPr: <ns0:pPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" algn="l"><ns0:defRPr sz="1650" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:defRPr></ns0:pPr>

originals.name: v2-63
originals.text: 更充分的协商和更广泛的认同。
originals.rPr: <ns0:rPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" sz="1650" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:rPr>
originals.pPr: <ns0:pPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" algn="l"><ns0:defRPr sz="1650" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:defRPr></ns0:pPr>

originals.name: v2-64
originals.text: 例如：人工智能规则讨论
originals.rPr: <ns0:rPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" sz="1500" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="687368" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:rPr>
originals.pPr: <ns0:pPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" algn="l"><ns0:defRPr sz="1500" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="687368" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:defRPr></ns0:pPr>

originals.name: v2-65
originals.text: 也应纳入发展中国家的需要。
originals.rPr: <ns0:rPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" sz="1500" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="687368" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:rPr>
originals.pPr: <ns0:pPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" algn="l"><ns0:defRPr sz="1500" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="687368" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:defRPr></ns0:pPr>

originals.name: v2-70
originals.text: 合作需要回应不同国家人民的
originals.rPr: <ns0:rPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" sz="1650" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:rPr>
originals.pPr: <ns0:pPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" algn="l"><ns0:defRPr sz="1650" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:defRPr></ns0:pPr>

originals.name: v2-71
originals.text: 生活与发展需要，持续关注
originals.rPr: <ns0:rPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" sz="1650" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:rPr>
originals.pPr: <ns0:pPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" algn="l"><ns0:defRPr sz="1650" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:defRPr></ns0:pPr>

originals.name: v2-72
originals.text: 成果能否普惠、运行能否持续。
originals.rPr: <ns0:rPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" sz="1650" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:rPr>
originals.pPr: <ns0:pPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" algn="l"><ns0:defRPr sz="1650" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="47594F" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:defRPr></ns0:pPr>

originals.name: v2-73
originals.text: 例如：能力建设项目需要
originals.rPr: <ns0:rPr xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" sz="1500" b="0"><ns0:solidFill><ns0:srgbClr val="687368" /></ns0:solidFill><ns0:latin typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:ea typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /><ns0:cs typeface="Microsoft YaHei" /></ns0:rPr>
